critical_code_review_comments: properties.service.ts update(): handlePersistenceError re-throws non-QueryFailedError as-is, so BadRequestException from the normalizer propagates correctly - good. Note the transaction wraps deposit-first then base save, which is what makes the invalid-deposit rollback observable via API.
policies.service.ts upsert(): the manager-aware repo resolution is duplicated three times; a small private helper (resolveRepos(manager)) would remove the repetition, but behavior is correct.

The base-save-fails rollback direction is not reproducible through the public API in this environment (only 1 property, no unique-code collision path, no DB-level constraint reachable past DTO validation). It remains covered only by properties.service.spec.ts unit tests - acceptable, but worth noting no e2e coverage exists for that direction.
